title: Comparison of 22Mhz and 18Mhz High-frequency Probes for the Ultrasound Study of Temporal Arteries in Patients Suspected of Having Giant Cell Arteritis
brief_summary: Evaluation of the structural features of temporal arteritis using two frequencies probes: 18 and 22Mhz.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* sedimentation rate\> 50 mm/h or recent unusual headache or unusual fever, recent visual trouble or jaw claudication, or induration temporal arteritis

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous diagnosis of giant cell arteritis and relapse of the giant cell arteritis and opposition to participate
study_population: patients with suspicion of giant cell arteritis
